response.sql: SELECT o.orderbase as channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_fillcount, COUNT(*) as exec_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders o2 INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe2 ON oe2.ordersmark = o2.recordvault) as fraction FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON oe.ordersmark = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY o.orderbase;
